name: Borrowed Authority
window: ACTION:
windowEffect: Return 1 player's control token from your tactic pool and perform a tactical action in a non-home, non-Mecatol Rex system with no other player's units, using a command token from that player's reinforcements.

name: Seize Command
window: When you spend influence to gain 1 or more command tokens:
windowEffect: You may place 1 other player's control token in your tactic pool instead of gaining 1 of those command tokens.
permanentEffect: You can have only 1 of each player's control tokens in your tactic pool.

name: Diplomatic Immunity
permanentEffect: You do not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card. Other players cannot place your command tokens when resolving the primary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card.

name: Mandate of Presence
window: When you pass:
windowEffect: You may spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to resolve the primary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card.

name: Lobbyist Dues
window: When an agenda is resolved, if an outcome that you voted for or predicted is not resolved:
windowEffect: Gain commodities equal to the number of players who voted for the outcome that was resolved.

name: Tight Scheduling
window: After the first agenda is revealed during the agenda phase:
windowEffect:
Draw 3 cards from the agenda deck and place them in your hand.

When an agenda would be revealed:
You may reveal 1 agenda from your hand instead.

At the end of the agenda phase:
Place the remaining agendas on the bottom of the agenda deck in any order.

name: Echo of the Anvil
window: When you produce units:
windowEffect: Gain 1 trade good if you produced 2 or more non-fighter ships of the same type.

name: Factory Lease
window: During setup:
windowEffect:
Gain the "Factory Lease" promissory notes.

At the start of the agenda phase:
You may produce units with a cost of 4 or less, up to the number of Factory Lease attachments on the game board, in a system containing 1 of your space docks and no other players' ships.

name: Shared Discoveries
window: At the end of a player's tactical action in a non-home system:
windowEffect: You may spend 1 commodity to allow that player to explore a planet in the active system as if it had any planet trait.

name: Expeditionary Cache
window: Legacy:
windowEffect: This retired ability is retained only for existing games.

name: Colony Outposts
window: At the end of a tactical action during which you explored a planet:
windowEffect: You may spend 1 command token to reveal cards from that planet's exploration deck until you reveal an attachment. Resolve that card and shuffle the other revealed cards back into the deck.

name: Battle-Tested Designs
window: Legacy:
windowEffect: This retired ability is retained only for existing games.

name: Evolved Warforms
permanentEffect: Your mechs are treated as both ships and ground forces and have a move value of 1. Mechs that are not being transported count against your fleet pool.

name: Testing Yard
permanentEffect: One ship of each type in your home system does not count against capacity.

name: Ritual of Ascension
window: ACTION:
windowEffect: Purge 2 relic fragments to research 1 technology.

name: Primordial Secrets
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Choose 1 primordial technology to use during this game.
permanentEffect: You have 1 additional faction technology.

name: Forbidden Knowledge
permanentEffect: You cannot gain a primordial technology unless you own 4 technologies of its color, ignoring synergies. Other players cannot use the abilities of primordial technologies.

name: Sting of the Hive
window: When you produce 1 or more hits with a unit ability:
windowEffect:
You may cancel any number of those hits to place or move that many mine tokens into that system.

After movement, if the active system contains 1 or more of your ships:
You may remove any number of mine tokens from that system to produce that many hits on the active player's units or gain that many commodities.

name: Hive Echo
window: When you would use SPACE CANNON, ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE, or BOMBARDMENT (except during SPACE CANNON DEFENSE) in a system containing your ships:
windowEffect: A unit with that unit ability up to 2 systems away may use it as if it were in the active system.

name: Ignorant Discoveries
window: At the start of the status phase:
windowEffect: You may purge 1 technology and spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to research 2 technologies.

name: Reflections of the Void
window: When you move ships into a system with no planets:
windowEffect: You may place 1 reflection token in a system that contains a planet you control.
permanentEffect:
You may treat reflection tokens as frontier tokens for all purposes.

When a reflection token would be removed from the game board:
Purge it instead.

name: Commanding Presence
window: When you unlock a leader or purge a leader to resolve its ability:
windowEffect: Gain 1 command token.

name: Call of the Haunted
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Purge your alliance promissory note and 1 Revenant Pantheon card. Then, gain each of the leaders listed on that card.
permanentEffect: You have 1 additional leader of each type.

name: Allure of Darkness
window: At the start of the strategy phase:
windowEffect: Choose 1 other player's commander that does not have the lich token on it and place the lich token on it.

name: Thrones of Ruin
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Choose 1 throne legendary planet and place it in your home system.

name: Traces of Ruin
permanentEffect: Systems that contain throne planets are anomalies. Players may score public objectives even if they do not control the throne planets in their home system.

name: Cycle of Reclamation
window: During setup:
windowEffect:
Place the Moon Phase cards in your play area.

Once per action, when a unit is destroyed in a system containing or adjacent to your units:
Capture 1 neutral destroyer.

name: New Moon
window: When you perform a strategic action:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to capture 1 neutral cruiser.

name: Waning Moon
window: When you pass:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card and return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 5 or more to their reinforcements to research 1 technology.

name: Full Moon
window: At the end of your turn:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card and return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 4 or more to their reinforcements to place 1 structure from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

name: Waxing Moon
window: At the start of your turn:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card and return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 2 or more to their reinforcements to draw 2 action cards, then discard 1 action card.

name: Half Moon
window: ACTION:
windowEffect: Exhaust this card and place 1 or more of your captured neutral units in a non-home system that contains no player's ships.

name: Lunar Eclipse
window: Legacy:
windowEffect: This retired ability is retained only for existing games.

name: Survivalists
permanentEffect: You may treat your damaged ships as galvanized during combat.

name: Last Stand
window: When your last unit would be destroyed during the "Assign Hits" step of combat:
windowEffect: You may roll that unit's combat dice. For each result equal to or greater than that unit's combat value, produce 1 hit. If all of your opponent's remaining participating units are destroyed by this roll, your unit is not destroyed.

name: Rallying Cry
permanentEffect: Systems that contain exactly 1 of your non-fighter ships gain PRODUCTION 2 as if they were units.

name: Interlocking Shields
window: Once per round of combat, when you cancel 1 or more hits:
windowEffect: Cancel 1 additional hit.

name: Shielded Transports
permanentEffect: Your non-fighter ships with SUSTAIN DAMAGE gain a capacity value of 1. If they already have a capacity value, increase that value by 1 instead.

name: Enhanced Fundamentals
window: Once per action, when you win a ground combat:
windowEffect: You may spend 3 trade goods to research a technology with no prerequisites.

name: Custom Rigs
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Choose 2 "Custom Rig" cards to gain.
permanentEffect: A player's units of the same type as a Custom Rig card in their play area gain that card's abilities; adjust those units' printed values by the amounts indicated on that card.

name: Drive Decoherence
window: When a player exhausts a Custom Rig card to resolve its ability:
windowEffect: They must destroy 1 unit of that type at the end of that action.

name: Repurposed Parts
window: Once per round of combat, when 1 of your units is destroyed:
windowEffect: You may produce 1 unit with a lower cost at a space dock you control.

name: Fragmentum Unleashed
window: After you purge 1 or more relic fragments:
windowEffect: You may place 1 Fragmentum token on your faction sheet that matches the color of 1 of those fragments.

name: Adaptive
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Gain the Dormant version of each of your faction components.
notes: This does not mean you gain your starting techs. Just that you start the game with the "Dormant" versions of all your components.
permanentEffect:
Components with an UNLEASH ability gain the following ability text:
"At the start of your turn:
You may pay this component's listed UNLEASH cost and purge it to gain its corresponding Unleashed counterpart. If the purged component was exhausted, gain its Unleashed counterpart exhausted."

name: Trovantous
window: At the start of the strategy phase:
windowEffect: Draw 1 random Stoneborn relic fragment.

name: Hydromorphic
permanentEffect: You cannot use the abilities of action cards.
window: At the start of the strategy phase:
windowEffect: Draw 2 action cards and 2 random "Hydromorphic" cards. Choose 1 Hydromorphic card to keep and return the other to the Hydromorphic deck.

name: Fluid Transfer
permanentEffect: Hydromorphic cards may be exchanged as part of a transaction.

name: Hydrospheric Extraction
window: Once per action, when you gain control of a planet:
windowEffect: You may destroy 1 of your units on that planet to draw 1 action card.

name: Radiant Grafting
window: When your units enter into coexistence on a planet:
windowEffect: Choose 1 Radiant Grafting ability card to gain and place it face up in your play area.
permanentEffect:
At any time you have more Radiant Grafting ability cards than there are planets that have your coexisting units:
Remove Radiant Grafting ability cards until you do not.

name: Celestial Envoys
window: Once during each of your strategic actions, when a player resolves the secondary ability of your strategy card:
windowEffect: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements into coexistence on a non-home planet that contains that player's ground forces.

name: Custom Rig: Destroyer
window: When you activate a system:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card. During this tactical action, your destroyers have no capacity, and you may count them against the capacity values of your ships with capacity.
permanentEffect: Passive: -1 COMBAT value

name: Custom Rig: Cruiser
window: During the "Commit Ground Forces" step:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to commit any number of your cruisers from the space area of the active system to planets in that system. Return them to the space area at the end of the tactical action.
permanentEffect: Passive: COST -1
notes: This is exhausted at the same time as the other custom rigs, when you activate a system, but its effect is during the "Commit Ground Forces" step. The button won't appear unless you exhaust it beforehand.

name: Custom Rig: Carrier
window: When you activate a system:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card and reduce each of your carriers' capacity values by any amount. For every 2 by which a carrier's capacity value is reduced, apply +1 to its move value until the end of this action.
permanentEffect: Passive: SUSTAIN DAMAGE

name: Custom Rig: Dreadnought
window: When you activate a system:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card. Your dreadnoughts lose SUSTAIN DAMAGE, roll 3 additional dice for BOMBARDMENT, and ignore PLANETARY SHIELD.
permanentEffect: Passive: Capacity +1

name: Radiant Grafting: Flight
window: At the end of your tactical actions:
windowEffect: You may place your structures that are in space areas on planets you control in their respective systems.
permanentEffect: Your structures are also ships with a move value of 1 and count against your fleet pool. They cannot use unit abilities while in a space area. Blockaded structures in the space area of a system are destroyed.

name: Radiant Grafting: Claws
permanentEffect: Your structures are treated as ground forces and gain a combat value of 6 if they do not already have a combat value. They participate in combats where they are located. Your structures cannot be transported.

name: Radiant Grafting: Parturition
permanentEffect: Your PDS units and space docks gain a cost of 4 and may be produced by your units with PRODUCTION. Place those structures on any planets you control in the producing unit's system.

name: Radiant Grafting: Scales
permanentEffect: Your structures gain SUSTAIN DAMAGE if they do not have it. Your structures may use their SUSTAIN DAMAGE ability to cancel a hit that is produced against your ships in their system or ground forces on their planet.

name: Radiant Grafting: Phalanges
permanentEffect: Your mechs gain PRODUCTION 1 and SPACE CANNON 9 and are treated as structures for all purposes.
